run_parallel_threads: run a function across a list of args in parallel threads with a tqdm progress bar
run_cuda_parallel_threads: run a function across a list of args in parallel processes with CUDA support and tqdm progress
run_parallel_processes: run a function across a list of args in parallel processes using multiprocessing.Pool instead of threads
get_cpu_count: get the number of available CPUs for the current python process via os.sched_getaffinity
run_starcall_wrapper: run a function with unpacked positional args via the starcall wrapper for Process.Pool compatibility
